description.en_us: First pre-release of Gurkha Launcher: every Minecraft version plays with 500 MB of RAM, Minecraft 26.1 to 26.4 support, the Krypton Wrapper and LTW renderers, working CurseForge downloads, smaller APKs, fixes for 32-bit devices and a new khukuri logo. See https://github.com/kushaladhikari982648-lgtm/Gurkha-launcher/releases
